verdict.rationale: Lovable docs explicitly describe turning a published app into an MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI assistants, with configurable tools, sign-in, permissions, and access — directly matching the story. However, this is a one-way integration (Lovable app exposed as an MCP server to other agents) rather than Lovable itself connecting to external MCP servers, and no community evidence corroborates real-world usage or reliability of this feature.
